stem: Which of the following was a direct result of the 1957 launch of Sputnik 1?

options.label: A
options.text: The United States began a period of technology sharing with the Soviet Union.

options.label: B
options.text: The U.S. government founded a federal agency dedicated to space exploration.

options.label: C
options.text: The Soviet Union was unable to collect images of the United States from space.

options.label: D
options.text: The Soviet government collapsed because of economic competition.
